Remark
[Metrics on homogeneous quotients]

Source: petersen:page-0029 ↗ def:pet-ch1-riemannian-submersion ↗ def:pet-ch1-left-invariant-metric

Let $H\subset G$ be compact. If right translation by every $h\in H$ is an isometry of a metric on $G$, there is a unique metric on $G/H$ for which $G\to G/H$ is a Riemannian submersion. If the metric on $G$ is also left-invariant, the induced left action of $G$ on $G/H$ is isometric and transitive. The formalized quotient-metric result uses the more general hypothesis of an isometric action; homogeneity is not separately formalized.
